reasoning: Both attempts keep the hotbar working, drive Hover and Pressed from GuiState and shrink the pressed slot without moving the others. A wins because it passes every check and sets the selected stroke's Outer position explicitly, as the design asks. B fails StyLua on its own code and leaves the selected stroke at the Border default. B does handle the top stroke better: it uses a thin frame where A fades a full UIStroke with a gradient. That is smaller than B's formatting failure and missing stroke spec, so A is the version a reviewer would merge more readily.

criteria.note: Hotbar.luau keeps its `Selected`/`Select` props and wiring and moves the slot into HotbarSlot.luau. `Activated` still calls `props.Select(blockType.Name)` and `IsSelected` still compares against `props.Selected()`.

Uses `changed("GuiState", guiState)` on the slot's own button, so Hover and Pressed are internal state. Theme.Slot holds the fills (38,43,69), (49,56,88) and (29,33,54), and `IsSelected` stays prop-driven.

The TextButton stays a fixed 64x64 while the inner `Surface` frame shrinks to `PressedSize` 60. The swatch is `UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24)`, so it follows down to 36. The Outer stroke doesn't affect layout.
`Theme.foldOpacity` folds 0.8 into the bar (0.2), the slot surface, swatch, badge, key text and both strokes. Padding is 10, Gap 8, CornerRadius 14.

The selected stroke is right: a 3px UIStroke with `BorderStrokePosition.Outer`, white Color and a `UIGradient` from (255,210,90) to (255,128,26). The top-only stroke, though, is a full UIStroke faded with a rotated gradient rather than a thin top frame, so the sides still show near the top.
Slot UICorner is 12 and swatch is 8. The badge is an 18px TextLabel with `UDim.new(0.5,0)` corners, black at 0.45, BuilderSans Bold 12. The name's UIStroke is Contextual on the text.

The table covers Gilroy → Montserrat ExtraBold, letter spacing -0.5 dropped, and corner smoothing 0.6 → plain UICorner 12. It also covers layer opacity and the top stroke, and lists the interpretations it made.
luau-lsp, selene and StyLua all pass. The extra Theme module and stories are tidy supporting files.
Edits the `slot` function inside Hotbar.luau and keeps `Select`/`Selected`. A full-size `HitArea` TextButton keeps click and tap working.
`changed("GuiState", guiState)` on the HitArea drives the Body fill between (38,43,69), (49,56,88) and (29,33,54). `IsSelected` stays prop-driven.
The outer Frame stays a fixed 64x64 while `Body` shrinks to 60 and the swatch to 36, so the other slots don't move.
The bar is a `CanvasGroup` with `GroupTransparency = 0.2`. It keeps padding 10, slot gap 8 and corner 14.

The top stroke is a 2px `TopHighlight` frame at transparency 0.88, which is the right approach. The selected UIStroke has the white color and gradient but never sets `BorderStrokePosition = Outer`; it leans on the Border default.
Slot corner is 12 and swatch is 8. The badge is an 18px Frame with `UDim.new(0.5,0)` corners, black at 0.45, holding Bold 12 key text. The name's UIStroke is Contextual on the text.
Covers Gilroy → Montserrat, letter spacing, corner smoothing, the CanvasGroup trade-off, the top stroke and pressed sizing, giving design values next to each replacement.
Works logically, but StyLua fails on its own `SELECTED_GRADIENT` line, and the selected stroke doesn't state the Outer position the design asks for.

strengths: Passes every automatic check, including the Outer BorderStrokePosition on the selected stroke
Opacity is folded into every layer consistently through a shared helper
Pressed shrink happens inside a fixed cell, so the other slots don't move
Notes are thorough and point out the trade-offs
weaknesses: The top-only stroke is approximated with a gradient-faded full UIStroke, not a thin top frame
